capabilities: Edit project plans as interactive Gantt charts saved directly to Markdown
Reorder, nest and filter tasks and groups by stage
Insert task dates, priorities and progress from editor commands
Open charts in the current tab or beside a Markdown note
Resolve note links and embeds through Obsidian's metadata cache
extras: Desktop-only; mobile and pop-out windows are unverified. HTML export exists only in a separate desktop application, not this plugin. Manual installation from built packages; not yet reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Disable any earlier build using the ID project-planner first; the Markdown format is unchanged.
problem: Plain-Markdown project plans give no visual timeline, so task dates, dependencies, nesting and progress are hard to see and edit.

relations.evidence: Project Gantt's task syntax is based on the Tasks emoji metadata format
the plugin prefix changed: reassign shortcuts previously bound to obsidian-gantt-planner-plugin:

summary: Gantt chart editor that renders Markdown project plans as interactive charts and writes edits back to the notes.
